title: Set
description: A file in data/oracle/set/, one set per file, such as data/oracle/set/mh3.json. The identity of one product. Its name is a word, so it is held per language, under data/print/<lang>/set/. Corrections do not attach to sets.

set_code.description: The official code of the product, such as MH3. Directory names go lowercase around it.

released_at.description: The day the set was released.
